About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: I try to turn the ideas that come to mind into reality, and I keep learning new things along the way.
About.whoAmIDesc: Rather than boxing myself into a single area, I enjoy turning everything that interests me into a project. For a while I worked on game development; for now I have paused that journey and am focusing on more general projects: command-line tools, privacy-focused software, developer tools for AI, and most recently the stock market and financial markets. I am still at the beginning, but I don't just want things; I push myself a little further every day. When something really interests me, I can stay focused on it for a long time. New ideas keep coming to me, and sometimes something I start grows into a much bigger project than I expected. I like remembering details and combining what I have learned before with new ideas.
About.interest1: Command-Line Tools - I write fast, simple tools in Rust and Python that make my everyday tasks easier.
About.interest2: Privacy & Security - I value transparent tools that give users control over their own systems.
About.interest3: AI & Developer Tools - I try out tools that help me work more efficiently with language models.
About.interest4: Markets & Odds Analysis - I am learning how stock markets and betting odds work, and I build my own tools to analyse that data.
About.interest5: Linux & Open Source - Tools I use every day, and I enjoy sharing my projects as open source.
About.philosophyDesc: I always want to get better. Being told that I can't do something usually doesn't stop me. It makes me want to work harder. I like learning from my mistakes, moving forward, and constantly pushing myself a little further.
About.currentWorkDesc: At the moment I am focused on finishing my projects in different areas one after another. While I build analysis tools for stock and odds data, I am also developing this website and collecting what I build here.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what data is processed when you visit this website, under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Privacy.controllerDesc: The owner of this website and the data controller is Arda Gökçe Alkan. You can send privacy requests through the contact form or in writing.
Privacy.contactDesc: When you use the contact form, your name, email address, subject and message are processed only to reply to you. Your message is delivered to the site owner's mailbox through the email service Resend (Resend, Inc., USA), so your data is transferred abroad. You are asked to give separate explicit consent to this transfer with the checkbox on the form; if you do not consent, the form is not sent, but you can still reach me through other channels. Messages are deleted no later than 12 months after the reply.
Privacy.logsDesc: To prevent abuse of the form, your IP address is held briefly in server memory only and is never stored permanently. The infrastructure provider hosting this site may keep standard server logs (IP address, browser information, time of visit) for security and operation.
Privacy.cookiesDesc: This site does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. Only the following entries, which are necessary for the site to work, are used; they do not require consent:
Privacy.cookie1: NEXT_LOCALE (cookie, 1 year): remembers the language you chose.
Privacy.cookie2: theme (local storage): remembers your light or dark theme preference.
Privacy.cookie3: Signature animation flag (session storage): makes the intro animation play only once per session; cleared when the browser closes.
Privacy.thirdDesc: Project information is fetched from the GitHub API on the server; your browser does not connect to GitHub directly. Fonts are served from this site itself; no requests are sent to Google.
Privacy.rightsDesc: Under Article 11 of the KVKK and the GDPR, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, to request information, to have it corrected or deleted, to object to processing and to withdraw your explicit consent at any time. You can send requests through the contact form or in writing; requests are answered within 30 days. You may also lodge a complaint with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Authority or the data protection authority of your country.
Privacy.changesDesc: This policy may be updated when needed. The current version is always published on this page.
Privacy.formNotice: You can read how your data is processed in the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
Privacy.legalBasisDesc: Your personal data is collected electronically, only when you enter it into the contact form yourself. Replying to your message is based on legitimate interest under Article 5(2)(f) KVKK and Article 6(1)(f) GDPR; the transfer abroad is based on your explicit consent under Article 9 KVKK and Article 6(1)(a) GDPR. The short-lived IP check that prevents abuse is also based on legitimate interest.
Privacy.consentLabel: I give my explicit consent to my data being transferred abroad (Resend, USA), as described in the Privacy Policy, so that my message can be answered.
Privacy.consentRequired: Please tick the consent box to send the form.
